'''The Undertow''' was a seedy bar owned by a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], criminals and thugs went to the Undertow to avoid Imperial attention. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Galen Marek]] [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Galen Marek)|went]] there to find [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|disgraced]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] as part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] fake plot to overthrow [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. When Marek [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|threatened]] the owner about whether they knew where Kota was, the patrons started attacking the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], since due to the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], any Jedi they found would be placed with a bounty for the Empire. After finishing off the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Imperial Navy commando]]s arrived and after [[Death/Legends|killing]] them, Galen fought an [[Unidentified Shadow Guard (Nar Shaddaa)|Emperor's Shadow Guard]] and a squad of [[Shadow stormtrooper/Legends|Shadow Troopers]].
